fields.name: Canada suicide prevention hotline
fields.description: crisis helpline - available by call or text

fields.name: Kids help phone
fields.description: 24/7 helpline - available through call, facebook messenger or a live chat found on the website

fields.name: Youthspace
fields.description: crisis and emotions support chat service - text and online

fields.name: Gerstein Centre
fields.description: 24/7 crisis support via telephone - mobile crisis team may come and pick you up. Crisis beds available for short stays

fields.name: Trans lifeline
fields.description: a peer support phone line - primarily for trans and trans questioning people, but anyone else can call (just make sure to ask for the family and friends line)

fields.name: Youthline
fields.description: LGBTQ+ helpline - available via call or live chat, peer supporters to have a conversation with, they aren't counsellors

fields.name: What's up? Walk in!
fields.description: short term counselling services available by phone or video call

fields.name: Central Toronto Wellness Hub
fields.description: walk in counselling via phone or zoom - call required in order to access a session

fields.name: Youthlink
fields.description: both walk-in and ongoing online counselling options available - via video conferencing, call required to book sessions

fields.name: Strides Toronto
fields.description: ongoing counselling (3-5 months) offered - number provided is for an intake worker who will direct you to the service you need

fields.name: Central Toronto Youth Services
fields.description: both virtual and in-person services available - counselling and LGBTQ+ youth support, call for more information

fields.name: Yorktown Family Services
fields.description: phone + virtual counselling - ongoing therapy for 8-12 sessions within 15 weeks of service

fields.name: Hong Fook Mental Health Association
fields.description: walk-in counselling avaible, Short term virtual counselling of 4-6 sessions within 5 days (call or email to schedule a session) - primarily for asian identifying youth

fields.name: Mood Disorders Association of Ontario
fields.description: structured peer support + counselling and drop in one-on-one support available through phone or video call

fields.name: Bayridge Counselling Centres
fields.description: Virtual group workshops led by experienced therapists - groups vary in topics

fields.name: TeleCBT
fields.description: phone + virtual counselling (covered by OHIP) - duration will be discussed with your therapist, email info@telecbt.ca to sign up

fields.name: Wellness and Emotional Support (WES) for youth online
fields.description: email and live chat counselling services available - good confidential option for those worried about privacy

fields.name: CouchMD
fields.description: free phone consultation with a doctor (covered by OHIP) - furthur support will be given after consultation

fields.name: WoodGreen Walk in Counselling
fields.description: phone + virtual counselling - students aged under 16 require parental consent, call required to access services

fields.name: Friends of Ruby
fields.description: space for LGBTQ+ youth - mental health services, practical supports and housing

fields.name: BounceBack
fields.description: free skill building program to manage mild/moderate depression and stress through videos, activities, workbooks, etc. - there’s the option to work with a coach over 6 phone sessions

fields.name: MindBeacon
fields.description: begin with taking an assessment - an assigned therapist will make a 6-12 week personalized plan for readings/activities and checks up on you around once every two days - you can access your resources for up to a year(uses CBT), for students 16+ (covered by OHIP)

fields.name: AbilitiCBT
fields.description: comprised of 10 modules with activities, videos, and assignments based on cognitive behavioral therapy - an assigned therapist monitors your progress and checks in occasionally you can access your resources after the program ends, for students 16+

fields.name: Wellness Together Canada
fields.description: regular self-assessments to track progress, self guided courses and apps, online community, and one-on-one counseling - basically, making a mental toolkit for yourself!

fields.name: CIMHS
fields.description: an 8 session free interactive therapy program for depression - based on CBT - no therapist check-ins

fields.name: Online Therapy Unit
fields.description: for depression/anxiety, uses CBT techniques - therapist checks progress at a set time every week.
